Summary: Inspect repository file tree and git history
Description: Run directory listing and git log to enumerate all committed files. Document every file found and every expected file that is absent.
Acceptance Criteria: File tree is documented in discovery report with full paths. Git log shows only initial commit.

Summary: Determine platform and technology stack from .gitignore
Description: Analyse .gitignore entries to determine the intended Android platform, language (Kotlin), and build system (Gradle). Cross-reference with sibling project on same machine.
Acceptance Criteria: Platform confirmed as Android. Language inferred as Kotlin. Build system inferred as Gradle. Confidence levels recorded.

Description: List all absent files that downstream phases must create: build.gradle.kts, app/ module, learntrack_topics.json, .kiro/, scripts/, .github/. List open decisions needing user input.
Acceptance Criteria: All 7 gaps documented in discovery report. Each gap has a severity rating and a recommended resolution.

Description: Commit docs/discovery/learntrack-discovery-report.md to the main branch with a chore: commit message.
Acceptance Criteria: Commit exists on main branch. No source files were created or modified.

Summary: Write functional requirements FR-001 through FR-010
Description: Define each functional requirement with ID, description, acceptance criteria, and edge cases. Cover: JSON creation, status distribution, progress calculation, dashboard, topic list, topic detail, validation, error states.
Acceptance Criteria: All functional requirements have measurable acceptance criteria. Edge cases documented for each.

Description: Define NFRs: performance (load < 2 s on mid-range device), accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), data integrity, testability, and build reproducibility.
Acceptance Criteria: NFRs documented with measurable targets. Constraints section references scope doc.

Description: Produce scope document covering in-scope items
Acceptance Criteria: out-of-scope exclusions
column10: Scope doc exists, is committed, and matches requirements doc.

Description: Author learntrack-stitch-master-prompt.md specifying product name, platform (Android mobile), course stats (22/41/53.7%), and general design principles for all screens.
Acceptance Criteria: Master prompt is self-contained and copy-ready for manual Stitch execution.

Summary: Create course progress screen Stitch prompt
Description: Author course-progress-prompt.md with detailed specifications for dashboard, topic list, and topic detail screens including loading, error, and empty states.
Acceptance Criteria: Prompt specifies all required data values and UI states. No fabricated Stitch outputs.

Description: Author design-review-checklist.md with checkboxes for every screen and state specified in the Stitch prompts. Include accessibility and data accuracy items.
Acceptance Criteria: Checklist covers all screens, all states, and accessibility. Can be used post-Stitch-execution to verify designs.

Description: Define design tokens: color palette (Material 3 baseline), typography scale, spacing grid (4 dp base), border radii, elevation, and component states.
Acceptance Criteria: Design tokens are defined for all used UI elements. Material 3 dynamic color guidance included.

Description: List all screens (CourseProgressScreen, TopicListScreen, TopicDetailScreen) with their states, components used, and requirement references.
Acceptance Criteria: Every screen links to at least one functional requirement. All states are listed.

Description: Write learntrack-figma-handoff.md with component naming conventions, screen specs, interaction notes, design-to-implementation mapping, and manual Figma setup instructions.
Acceptance Criteria: Handoff is complete without requiring live Figma MCP. An implementer can follow it independently.

Summary: Define learntrack_topics.json schema and topic names
Description: Specify the JSON schema (topics array with id, name, status fields). Define 41 topic names for the AI & Python Technology Course in the order they appear in the file.
Acceptance Criteria: Schema defined. All 41 topic names listed. Status distribution confirmed: 22 completed / 19 not_started.

Description: Create app/src/main/assets/learntrack_topics.json with all 41 topics. Assign statuses per the authoritative distribution. Ensure valid JSON syntax.
Acceptance Criteria: File exists, parses without error, contains exactly 41 topics.

Description: Run JSON validation: parse file, check each topic has id/name/status, count completed (22) and not_started (19), check for duplicate ids.
Acceptance Criteria: Validation passes. Counts are exactly 22/19/41. No duplicate ids. All fields present.

Summary: Implement domain model: Topic and TopicStatus
Description: Create Topic data class and TopicStatus enum in com.learntrack.data.model. Add kotlinx.serialization annotations for JSON mapping.
Acceptance Criteria: Topic.kt and TopicStatus.kt (or single file) exists. Compiles without error.

Description: Create CalculateProgressUseCase that accepts List<Topic> and returns CourseProgress with total, completed, notStarted, completionPercentage. Edge cases: empty list returns 0.0%.
Acceptance Criteria: Use case implemented. Handles all documented edge cases.

Description: Write ProgressCalculatorTest covering: 22/41=53.7%, 0/41=0.0%, 41/41=100.0%, empty list=0.0%, 1/2=50.0%.
Acceptance Criteria: All 5 test cases pass on gradlew testDebugUnitTest.

Description: Create CourseProgressScreen composable showing progress percentage, completed/total counts, progress bar, and loading/error/empty states. Collect state from CourseProgressViewModel.
Acceptance Criteria: Screen renders without crashing. All states are handled. Progress bar reflects 53.7% correctly.

Description: Create TopicListScreen composable rendering a scrollable LazyColumn of all 41 topics. Each row shows topic name and a status badge (Completed / Not Started) styled with Material 3.
Acceptance Criteria: All 41 topics render. Status badges are visually distinct. List scrolls.

Description: Create TopicDetailScreen composable showing topic name, status, and back navigation button.
Acceptance Criteria: Detail screen renders name and status. Back navigation returns to topic list.

Summary: Add content descriptions and accessibility attributes
Description: Add contentDescription to all interactive elements. Ensure progress percentage is expressed as text. Verify contrast ratios meet WCAG 2.1 AA.
Acceptance Criteria: All interactive elements have contentDescription. Progress percentage is in text.

Description: Test three scenarios: valid JSON asset loads successfully; missing file emits Error; malformed JSON emits Error. Use MockK or test-asset injection.
Acceptance Criteria: All 3 repository test cases pass.

Description: Test CourseProgressViewModel: initial state is Loading; successful load emits Success with correct progress; repository error emits Error.
Acceptance Criteria: All 3 ViewModel test cases pass.

Summary: Write Compose UI tests for dashboard and topic list
Description: Write CourseProgressScreenTest asserting 53.7% text, 22/41 counts, and progress bar exist. Write TopicListScreenTest asserting 41 rows and status badge text.
Acceptance Criteria: UI tests pass on connectedDebugAndroidTest or Robolectric.

Description: Write TopicDistributionRegressionTest that reads learntrack_topics.json from assets and asserts: total==41, completed==22, not_started==19. This test must run on every CI build.
Acceptance Criteria: Regression test exists, passes, and is wired into the CI pipeline.

Description: Author .kiro/skills/learntrack-repository-analysis/SKILL.md with purpose, when-to-use, required inputs, procedure, constraints, outputs, and verification sections.

Description: Author learntrack-jira-traceability/SKILL.md. Create all 12 implementation prompts in docs/kiro-prompts/ numbered 01 through 12.
Acceptance Criteria: Skill and all 12 prompts exist, are copy-ready, and reference correct artifact paths.

Description: Execute every AC-1 through AC-8 check. Record result (pass/fail/skip) for each item. Document any waivers.
